title: Payment decision context experiment
question: A repeated payment request arrives for API contract v2 with the same idempotency key but a different payload. What action and evidence are required?

procedures.title: Payment idempotency
procedures.procedure: Reject a repeated payment request when the idempotency key already exists with a different payload. Preserve the original request identifier for traceability.

procedures.title: API contract compatibility
procedures.procedure: Before changing an API contract, preserve backward compatibility and add contract tests for the approved v2 behavior.

procedures.title: Integration audit traceability
procedures.procedure: Every integration decision must preserve a correlation identifier, source system, and timestamp for audit review.

procedures.title: Refund approval
procedures.procedure: Approve a synthetic refund only after validating the original payment reference and recording an approval reference.

procedures.title: Fraud escalation
procedures.procedure: Escalate a synthetic fraud indicator to manual review and preserve the risk case identifier before any payment action.
